# Overview

The child questions (20 on supernatural monitoring, 16 on the supreme high god) are only asked when their
parent question is answered "Yes". We therefore model two parts:

1. **Parent models** (2): is supernatural monitoring present; is a supreme high god present.
   "Supreme high god present" includes "No" inferred when supernatural beings are absent
   (supernatural beings are present in > 90% of entries, so we do not model them separately).
2. **Conditional models** (36): each child question, among entries where the parent is "Yes".

The unconditional probability (share of *all* religions with the feature) follows from the two parts:

$$
P(\text{child} = \text{yes}) = P(\text{parent} = \text{yes}) \times P(\text{child} = \text{yes} \mid \text{parent} = \text{yes})
$$

The likelihood of the unconditional data factorises in the same way, so fitting the two parts separately is
equivalent to a joint model in which they share no parameters. We compute the unconditional curves by
multiplying posterior draws of the two parts. Question 3218 (permissible to worship other gods) is
conditional only: its answer is inferred "Yes" (not "No") when there is no supreme high god, so its
unconditional probability is not this product.

**Model** (each parent and child question separately; groups and texts together):

$$
\text{logit}(p) = \alpha + \beta_\text{time} \cdot \text{time} + \beta_\text{text} \cdot \text{text}
+ \beta_\text{time:text} \cdot \text{time} \cdot \text{text} + u_\text{world region},
\quad u \sim \text{Normal}(0, \sigma)
$$

- time: `year_from` / 1000 (0 = 0 CE); $\beta_\text{time}$ is the slope for groups (log-odds per 1,000 years)
- text: 1 for religious texts, 0 for groups; $\beta_\text{text}$ is the text-group difference at 0 CE,
  $\beta_\text{time:text}$ the difference in slope (so the slope for texts is $\beta_\text{time} + \beta_\text{time:text}$)
- conflicting answers kept, weighted 1/n (`weights(weight)`); all entries kept
- **robustness**: the same models on groups only (without the text terms)

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py`. Fits are saved in `fits/` (delete them to refit),
figures in `fig/baseline/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/baseline/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/baseline"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

# lines in the figures: groups and texts (main model), groups only (robustness)
colors <- c(groups = "#2a78d6", texts = "#1baf7a", "groups only" = "#898781")
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
d <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    time = year_from / 1000,
    text = as.integer(poll == "text")
  )

# parent question of each family of child questions
parent_of <- c(monitoring = "supernatural monitoring present", shg = "supreme high god present")

# child questions in topic order (as in temporal/)
topic_order <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
all_questions <- c(unname(parent_of), topic_order)

questions <- d |>
  distinct(family, question_short) |>
  filter(question_short %in% all_questions) |>
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "shg")))
stopifnot(setequal(topic_order, filter(questions, family != "parent")$question_short))

# samples
d_parent <- d |> filter(question_short %in% parent_of)         # parent questions (incl. inferred "No" for SHG)
d_cond <- d |> filter(family != "parent", !inferred)            # child questions, conditional
d_uncond <- d |> filter(family != "parent")                     # child questions, unconditional (only for observed shares)
```

Entries per sample:

```{r data_overview}
bind_rows(
  d_parent |> mutate(sample = "parent questions"),
  d_cond |> mutate(sample = "child questions, conditional"),
  d_uncond |> mutate(sample = "child questions, unconditional")
) |>
  group_by(sample, poll) |>
  summarise(entries = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = poll, values_from = entries)
```

Entries per world region (groups and texts):

```{r data_regions}
bind_rows(d_parent, d_cond) |>
  distinct(entry_id, poll, world_region) |>
  count(world_region, poll) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = poll, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(desc(group + text))
```

# Model and priors

- intercept (log-odds at 0 CE, groups): normal(0, 1.5)
- all slopes (time, text, time:text): normal(0, 1)
- SD of world-region intercepts: exponential(1)

```{r model}
formulas <- list(
  main = bf(answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time * text + (1 | world_region)),
  groups = bf(answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 | world_region))
)

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)

# data per model set (each question is then fitted separately)
sets <- list(
  main = bind_rows(d_parent, d_cond),
  groups = bind_rows(d_parent, d_cond) |> filter(poll == "group")
)
```

`0 + Intercept` is the brms way of not centering the predictors, so the intercept prior is at 0 CE.

## Prior predictive check

Prior-only fit of the main model (data: is unquestionably good).

```{r prior_check, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3.5}
fit_prior <- brm(
  formulas$main,
  data = filter(sets$main, question_short == "is unquestionably good"),
  family = bernoulli(),
  prior = priors,
  sample_prior = "only",
  chains = 4, iter = 1000, seed = 2026, refresh = 0,
  file = "fits/baseline_prior", file_refit = "on_change"
)

# prior curves for groups in a new (random) world region
prior_curves <- tibble(time = seq(-3.5, 2, by = 0.1), text = 0, weight = 1, world_region = "new region") |>
  tidybayes::add_epred_draws(fit_prior, ndraws = 200, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian")

p_prior_curves <- ggplot(prior_curves, aes(time * 1000, .epred, group = .draw)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "P(yes)")
save_plot(p_prior_curves, "prior_curves", 6, 3.5)

# share of yes implied by the priors, against the observed share
p_prior_share <- pp_check(fit_prior, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
save_plot(p_prior_share, "prior_share_yes", 6, 3.5)
```

# Fit

Each model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
templates <- map2(formulas, sets, function(formula, data) {
  suppressWarnings(brm(formula, data = data, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors, chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
})

fit_question <- function(set, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/baseline_%s_%s.rds", set, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    templates[[set]],
    newdata = filter(sets[[set]], question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 2026, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

fits <- crossing(set = names(sets), question = all_questions) |>
  mutate(fit = map2(set, question, fit_question))
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^sd_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)

# worst values per model set
diagnostics |>
  group_by(set) |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail), divergences = sum(divergences))

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Coefficients

```{r estimates}
# posterior summaries per fit (main model: also level and slope for texts)
estimates <- fits |>
  mutate(est = map2(fit, set, function(fit, set) {
    draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^sd_", regex = TRUE)
    if (set == "main") {
      draws <- mutate_variables(draws, b_Intercept_text = b_Intercept + b_text, b_time_text = b_time + `b_time:text`)
    }
    summarise_draws(draws, mean, ~ quantile(.x, c(0.025, 0.975))) |>
      rename(lower = `2.5%`, upper = `97.5%`)
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)))

# coefficient plot, one point per line (groups, texts, groups only)
coef_plot <- function(est, xlab) {
  ggplot(est, aes(mean, question, colour = line)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

## Time slopes

Change in log-odds per 1,000 years (95% interval): groups and texts (main model), groups only (robustness).

```{r slopes, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 11}
p_slopes <- estimates |>
  filter((set == "main" & variable %in% c("b_time", "b_time_text")) | (set == "groups" & variable == "b_time")) |>
  mutate(line = case_when(set == "groups" ~ "groups only", variable == "b_time" ~ "groups", TRUE ~ "texts")) |>
  coef_plot("Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)")
save_plot(p_slopes, "slopes", 9, 11)
```

## Level at 0 CE

Log-odds of "yes" at 0 CE in an average world region (95% interval): groups ($\alpha$) and texts
($\alpha + \beta_\text{text}$) from the main model, groups only (robustness).

```{r intercepts, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 11}
p_intercepts <- estimates |>
  filter((set == "main" & variable %in% c("b_Intercept", "b_Intercept_text")) | (set == "groups" & variable == "b_Intercept")) |>
  mutate(line = case_when(set == "groups" ~ "groups only", variable == "b_Intercept" ~ "groups", TRUE ~ "texts")) |>
  coef_plot("Log-odds at 0 CE")
save_plot(p_intercepts, "intercepts", 9, 11)
```

## World regions

Spread of the world-region intercepts ($\sigma$):

```{r region_sd, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 11}
p_region_sd <- estimates |>
  filter(variable == "sd_world_region__Intercept") |>
  mutate(line = if_else(set == "main", "groups", "groups only")) |>
  coef_plot("SD of world-region intercepts (log-odds)")
save_plot(p_region_sd, "region_sd", 9, 11)
```

World-region intercepts (posterior mean, log-odds relative to the average region), groups-only model
(in the main model, groups and texts share the region intercepts, and texts are concentrated in a few regions).
Numbers in the tiles: group entries in that world region for that question; on the axis: group entries
in the world region for any question. Black border and bold number: credible (95% interval excludes 0, i.e.
the region differs from the average region).

```{r region_effects, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 10}
# entries per question and world region in the groups-only data, and per world region overall
region_n <- sets$groups |> group_by(question = question_short, world_region) |> summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop")
region_total <- sets$groups |> group_by(world_region) |> summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id))
region_labels <- setNames(paste0(region_total$world_region, " (", region_total$n, ")"), region_total$world_region)

region_effects <- fits |>
  filter(set == "groups") |>
  mutate(re = map(fit, function(fit) {
    r <- ranef(fit)$world_region[, , "Intercept"]
    tibble(world_region = rownames(r), estimate = r[, "Estimate"], lower = r[, "Q2.5"], upper = r[, "Q97.5"])
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(re) |>
  left_join(region_n, by = c("question", "world_region")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)), credible = lower > 0 | upper < 0)

p_region_effects <- ggplot(region_effects, aes(world_region, question, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_tile(data = filter(region_effects, credible), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n, fontface = if_else(credible, "bold", "plain")), size = 2.3, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = region_labels) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2a78d6", mid = "white", high = "#eb6834", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "log-odds") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_plot(p_region_effects, "region_effects", 9, 10)
```

# Curves over time

Population-level curves (average world region; mean and 95% interval) for groups and texts (main model) and
groups only (robustness), with the observed share yes per era (points; weighted; size = number of entries).

```{r predictions}
eras <- c(-Inf, -1000, 0, 500, 1000, 1500, Inf)
era_labels <- c("< -1000", "-1000-0", "0-500", "500-1000", "1000-1500", "> 1500")
era_mid <- c(-1500, -500, 250, 750, 1250, 1750)  # where the points are drawn

# predicted P(yes) per posterior draw (1,000 draws) on a time grid, for groups and texts
grid <- crossing(text = c(0, 1), time = seq(-3.5, 2, by = 0.05)) |> mutate(weight = 1)
predict_grid <- function(fit, set) {
  newdata <- if (set == "main") grid else filter(grid, text == 0)
  list(newdata = newdata, p = posterior_epred(fit, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA, ndraws = 1000))
}
summarise_pred <- function(pred, set) {
  pred$newdata |>
    mutate(
      mean = colMeans(pred$p),
      lower = apply(pred$p, 2, quantile, 0.025),
      upper = apply(pred$p, 2, quantile, 0.975),
      line = case_when(set == "groups" ~ "groups only", text == 0 ~ "groups", TRUE ~ "texts")
    )
}

preds <- fits |> mutate(pred = map2(fit, set, predict_grid))
curves <- preds |>
  mutate(curve = map2(pred, set, summarise_pred)) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)

# observed share yes per era, for groups and texts
observed_shares <- function(data) {
  data |>
    mutate(era = cut(year_from, eras, labels = era_mid), line = if_else(poll == "text", "texts", "groups")) |>
    group_by(question = question_short, line, era) |>
    summarise(yes = weighted.mean(answer_value, weight), n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(year = as.numeric(as.character(era)))
}

curve_plot <- function(curves, observed, ncol) {
  ggplot(curves, aes(time * 1000)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = line), alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean, colour = line)) +
    geom_point(data = observed, aes(year, yes, colour = line, size = n), alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = all_questions), ncol = ncol) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "Year (year_from)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

## Child questions, unconditional (derived)

P(parent = yes) x P(child = yes | parent = yes), multiplied per posterior draw (main model).
Conditional (solid lines, filled points) and unconditional (dashed lines, open points) for groups and texts;
points: observed share per era (unconditional: inferred answers included).
3218 (permissible to worship other god?) has no unconditional version.

```{r unconditional}
pred_of <- function(set, question) preds$pred[[which(preds$set == set & preds$question == question)]]

unconditional <- preds |>
  filter(question %in% topic_order, question != "permissible to worship other god?") |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(pred = pmap(list(set, family, pred), function(set, family, pred) {
    parent <- pred_of(set, parent_of[[as.character(family)]])
    list(newdata = pred$newdata, p = pred$p * parent$p)
  }))

curves_uncond <- unconditional |>
  mutate(curve = map2(pred, set, summarise_pred)) |>
  select(set, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)
```

```{r curves_unconditional, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 18}
# conditional and unconditional curves (main model) and observed shares, for groups and texts
curves_both <- bind_rows(
  curves |> filter(set == "main", question %in% topic_order) |> mutate(type = "conditional"),
  curves_uncond |> filter(set == "main") |> mutate(type = "unconditional")
)
observed_both <- bind_rows(
  observed_shares(d_cond) |> mutate(type = "conditional"),
  observed_shares(filter(d_uncond, question_short != "permissible to worship other god?")) |> mutate(type = "unconditional")
)

p_curves_uncond <- ggplot(curves_both, aes(time * 1000)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = line, group = interaction(line, type)), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean, colour = line, linetype = type)) +
  geom_point(data = observed_both, aes(year, yes, colour = line, shape = type, size = n), alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = topic_order), ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors[c("groups", "texts")]) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors[c("groups", "texts")]) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(conditional = "solid", unconditional = "dashed")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(conditional = 16, unconditional = 1)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year (year_from)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, fill = NULL, linetype = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_curves_uncond, "curves_unconditional", 12, 18)
```

## Decomposition of the change over time

Change in P(yes) from 0 CE to 1500 CE for groups (main model; mean and 95% interval): parent question,
child question given the parent (conditional), and both together (unconditional).

```{r decomposition, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 10}
# change in P(yes) between two times, for groups (text = 0), per posterior draw
change_p <- function(pred, from = 0, to = 1.5) {
  i <- which(pred$newdata$text == 0 & abs(pred$newdata$time - from) < 1e-8)
  j <- which(pred$newdata$text == 0 & abs(pred$newdata$time - to) < 1e-8)
  diff <- pred$p[, j] - pred$p[, i]
  tibble(mean = mean(diff), lower = quantile(diff, 0.025), upper = quantile(diff, 0.975))
}

decomposition <- unconditional |>
  filter(set == "main") |>
  mutate(
    parent = map2(set, family, ~ change_p(pred_of(.x, parent_of[[as.character(.y)]]))),
    conditional = map2(set, question, ~ change_p(pred_of(.x, .y))),
    unconditional = map(pred, change_p)
  ) |>
  select(question, family, parent, conditional, unconditional) |>
  pivot_longer(c(parent, conditional, unconditional), names_to = "part", values_to = "change") |>
  unnest(change) |>
  mutate(
    question = factor(question, levels = rev(topic_order)),
    part = factor(part, levels = c("parent", "conditional", "unconditional"))
  )

p_decomposition <- ggplot(decomposition, aes(mean, question, colour = part)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(parent = "#898781", conditional = "#2a78d6", unconditional = "#eb6834")) +
  labs(x = "Change in P(yes), 0 CE to 1500 CE (groups)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_decomposition, "decomposition", 9, 10)
```

# Posterior predictive checks

Observed share yes (points) against the 95% posterior predictive interval (bars), per era, for groups and
texts (main model) and groups only (robustness). Each model on its own data.

```{r ppc}
# observed and predicted (weighted) share yes per era and poll, for one fit
ppc_era <- function(fit, data) {
  yrep <- posterior_predict(fit, ndraws = 1000)
  keys <- distinct(data, poll, era)
  pmap_dfr(keys, function(poll, era) {
    w <- data$weight * (data$poll == poll & data$era == era)
    prop <- as.vector(yrep %*% w) / sum(w)
    tibble(poll = poll, era = era, observed = sum(w * data$answer_value) / sum(w),
           lower = quantile(prop, 0.025), upper = quantile(prop, 0.975))
  })
}

ppc <- fits |>
  mutate(data = map2(set, question, ~ filter(sets[[.x]], question_short == .y) |>
    mutate(era = cut(year_from, eras, labels = era_labels)))) |>
  mutate(check = map2(fit, data, ppc_era)) |>
  select(set, question, check) |>
  unnest(check) |>
  mutate(line = case_when(set == "groups" ~ "groups only", poll == "group" ~ "groups", TRUE ~ "texts"))

ppc_plot <- function(ppc_long, ncol) {
  ppc_long |>
    mutate(era = factor(era, levels = rev(era_labels))) |>
    ggplot(aes(y = era, colour = line)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
    geom_point(aes(x = observed), size = 1.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
    facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = all_questions), ncol = ncol) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(x = "Share yes", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

```{r ppc_parent, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
p_ppc_parent <- ppc_plot(filter(ppc, question %in% parent_of), ncol = 2)
save_plot(p_ppc_parent, "ppc_parent", 9, 4)
```

```{r ppc_conditional, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 22}
p_ppc_cond <- ppc_plot(filter(ppc, question %in% topic_order), ncol = 4)
save_plot(p_ppc_cond, "ppc_conditional", 12, 22)
```

Share of observed values outside the 95% interval:

```{r ppc_summary}
ppc |>
  mutate(outside = observed < lower | observed > upper) |>
  group_by(line) |>
  summarise(groups = n(), share_outside = round(mean(outside), 2), outside = sum(outside), .groups = "drop")
```
